t: Portal Computation: Bandwidth-Delay Desk — Simple
name: Portal Computation: Bandwidth-Delay Desk — Simple
title: Portal Computation: Bandwidth-Delay Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Every link's in-flight capacity is bandwidth × delay: the desk computes the bandwidth-delay product per link — the bytes that must be in flight to fill the pipe. A 1 Gbps link with 100 ms delay holds 12.5 MB in flight.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: BDP: 1 Gbps x 100 ms = 12.5 MB. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a fat pipe with a tiny window.

t: Portal Computation: Distributed Design Studio — Simple
name: Portal Computation: Distributed Design Studio — Simple
title: Portal Computation: Distributed Design Studio — Simple
